points.text: The White House replaced national cyber director Sean Cairncross with Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies, while JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard reported customer data exposure in third-party cyberattacks.
The Senate passed a bipartisan bill to speed permitting for energy and infrastructure projects, but the measure faces further hurdles in the House.
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani proposed closing Rikers Island by 2032 and moving its remaining population to smaller city jails, requiring a change to the legal deadline.
President Donald Trump threatened a “tremendous tax” on US companies that build data centers abroad.
Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Italy-based Bending Spoons for an enterprise value of $3.68 billion, with the deal expected to close in early 2027.
